qualityWarnings.message: Issuer consolidated net revenues before gaming tax, using each cited report's presentation and comparative columns. Gaming tax is an expense, not an extra amount to add to already reported net revenues. Older pre-IFRS15 commission presentations are not retrospectively restated without a published bridge. Reviewed fields are consolidated revenue, reported operating profit, income-statement D&A, pretax profit, income tax, attributable earnings and separately reported interest. Core EBITDA is operating profit plus reported D&A, not adjusted property EBITDA. Gross profit is not reported and is not invented. Historical accounting presentations and published comparative restatements are retained; no unpublished IFRS15 bridge is invented. Unreviewed balance-sheet, cash-flow and functional expense classifications are not certified. Native FMP model responses and saved user assumptions are not rewritten.
